reconfigure.title: Reconfigure VIDAA Smart TV

upload.title: Upload Client Certificate or App
upload.description: VIDAA TVs require TLS client certificates for secure communication. Upload the official VIDAA / RemoteNOW Android app package (.apk / .xapk) or an extracted keystore (.p12 / .pfx / .pem / .crt). Home Assistant will extract and secure the certificates automatically.

certs.title: Client Certificates
certs.description: Configure TLS/SSL client certificates for communicating with your VIDAA Smart TV. Place your certificates in {cert_dir} ({cert_file} and {key_file}).

init.title: VIDAA Smart TV Options
init.description: Select an options category to configure:

power_network.title: Power & Network Options
power_network.description: Configure Wake-on-LAN power on and secondary network interface (Wi-Fi or Ethernet). Active Primary MAC: {primary_mac}.

data_description.enable_wol: Broadcasts magic packets to wake the TV from deep sleep or standby when network interfaces power down.
data_description.secondary_mac_address: Enter the TV's second physical network interface MAC (e.g. Ethernet MAC if connected via Wi-Fi, or vice-versa). WoL magic packets will be broadcast simultaneously to both MAC addresses.

playback_sources.title: Playback & Sources
playback_sources.description: Configure input sources, app list, and media playback controls.

data.include_apps_in_sources: Include streaming apps in source list

data_description.include_apps_in_sources: Displays installed streaming apps (Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, etc.) alongside physical HDMI inputs in the Media Player source dropdown.
data_description.sources: Select which inputs and apps appear in the source selector. Leave empty or select all to display every detected source.
data_description.enable_media_controls: Exposes media transport controls (Play, Pause, Stop, Previous, Next) on the Media Player card for supported apps and media playback.
data_description.enable_cec_names: Replaces generic input labels like 'HDMI 2' with active device names reported over HDMI-CEC (e.g. 'PlayStation 5', 'Apple TV').
data_description.enable_app_icons: Displays remote app logos from VIDAA's CDN on the Media Player, Active App sensor, and Media Browser. Automatically falls back to Material Design Icons if unreachable; disable to stay 100% local.
data_description.playback_debounce: Duration in seconds to filter out rapid transient state flickers when streaming apps launch or buffer.

features_remote.title: Entities & Remote Controls
features_remote.description: Configure entity toggles, picture calibration, sound presets, and remote key timings.

data_description.enable_picture_controls: Creates picture mode selector and backlight, brightness, and contrast slider entities. Disabled by default; only supported on select TV models with MQTT picture menus. Run Probe Capabilities first.
data_description.enable_sound_controls: Creates an equalizer sound preset selector entity (Standard, Theatre, Music, Speech, Late Night, Sports). Disabled by default; model dependent.
data_description.enable_audio_only: Creates a switch entity to turn off the display panel while keeping audio streaming active (ideal for music, radio, and podcasts).
data_description.key_delay: Delay between sequential keystrokes when sending remote button sequences or automated commands.
data_description.key_repeat: Number of times a keystroke is transmitted per command when no explicit repeat count is specified.

security.title: Connection & Security
security.description: Select TV OEM brand, authentication profile, encryption, and optional client certificates.

data_description.auth_profile: Select the encryption and pairing protocol. 'Auto Detect' automatically negotiates based on TV model and firmware version.
data_description.brand: Select the TV manufacturer brand to load OEM-specific MQTT topics and client IDs. Use 'Auto Detect' unless pairing fails.
data_description.use_ssl: Enables TLS/SSL encryption on port 36669. Required for all modern VIDAA TVs (VIDAA U4+). Only disable for older pre-2022 firmware on port 3160.
data_description.cert_file: Upload an updated VIDAA APK, XAPK, or .p12 keystore to extract and install new certificates into Home Assistant storage.

manual_certificates.name: Manual Certificate Paths (Advanced)
manual_certificates.description: Enter custom filesystem paths for client certificate and private key files.

send_key.name: Send Key
send_key.description: Send a key press or sequence of key presses to the TV.

key.name: Key
key.description: Key code to send (e.g. KEY_POWER, KEY_HOME, KEY_VOLUMEUP).

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key press.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Delay in seconds between repeated key presses.

send_key_sequence.name: Send Key Sequence
send_key_sequence.description: Send a sequence of remote key commands with configurable delay between keys.

sequence.name: Key Sequence
sequence.description: List of key codes or comma-separated keys to send sequentially (e.g. ["home", "down", "ok"]).

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Delay in seconds between each sequential key press.

change_channel.name: Change Channel
change_channel.description: Directly tune to a numeric TV channel by dispatching sequential number keys.

channel.name: Channel Number
channel.description: The channel number to tune to (e.g. 701, 10, 7).

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Send OK/Enter immediately after digits to tune without waiting for TV timeout.

launch_app.name: Launch App
launch_app.description: Launch a Smart TV application by name or direct URL.

app.name: Application Name or URL
app.description: The app name or deep link URL. Optional when an application ID is supplied.

app_id.name: Application ID
app_id.description: Optional TV application ID to use instead of the ID from the app list.

app_name.name: Application Name Override
app_name.description: Optional application name to include in the launch request.

url.name: Launch URL
url.description: Optional URL or deep link to pass to the application.

set_picture_setting.name: Set Picture Setting
set_picture_setting.description: Change a specific TV picture menu setting or calibration parameter.

menu_id.name: Menu ID
menu_id.description: Numeric menu ID (e.g. 91 for Picture Mode, 92 for Backlight, 93 for Brightness, 94 for Contrast).

menu_value.name: Menu Value
menu_value.description: Setting value or preset mode name.

set_sound_setting.name: Set Sound Setting
set_sound_setting.description: Change a specific TV sound menu setting or equalizer preset.

menu_id.name: Menu ID
menu_id.description: Numeric menu ID (e.g. 1 for Sound Mode).

send_text_input.name: Send Text Input
send_text_input.description: Send virtual keyboard text to an active on-screen input field or browser search bar.

confirm.title: Re-pair with VIDAA TV
confirm.description:
Home Assistant can no longer authenticate with your VIDAA TV ({ip_address}). The TV broker has rejected the stored access and refresh tokens (this usually happens after a firmware update or hard power-cycle).

Click **Submit** to start the pairing flow. Make sure your TV is powered **on** (not in standby) — a PIN code will appear on screen.
